definitions.explanation: with breakfast included; breakfast included (as part of a hotel or accommodation package)

examples.japanese: {朝食付|ちょうしょくつ}き⟦プラン→プラン：00345_puran⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{予約|よやく}した→予約する：22989_yoyakusuru⟧。
examples.english: I made a reservation with a breakfast-included plan.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{料金|りょうきん}→料金：03797_ryoukin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{朝食付|ちょうしょくつ}きです⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
{朝食付|ちょうしょくつ}き⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ホテル→ホテル：01027_hoteru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}している→探す：00493_sagasu⟧。
examples.english: I'm looking for a hotel with breakfast included.

notes:
{朝食付|ちょうしょくつ}き is a common expression in travel and accommodation contexts, combining ⟦{朝食|ちょうしょく}→朝食：03122_choushoku⟧ (breakfast) + ⟦{付|つ}き→付き：26333_tsuki⟧ (attached/included).

ACCOMMODATION TERMS:
- {素泊|すどま}り (room only, no meals)
- {朝食付|ちょうしょくつ}き (with breakfast)
- ⟦{夕食付|ゆうしょくつ}き→夕食付き：30782_yuushokutsuki⟧ (with dinner)
- {二食付|にしょくつ}き (with two meals - breakfast and dinner)
- {一泊二食|いっぱくにしょく} (one night with two meals)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {朝食付|ちょうしょくつ}き⟦プラン→プラン：00345_puran⟧ (breakfast-included plan)
- {朝食付|ちょうしょくつ}き⟦{宿泊|しゅくはく}→宿泊：03216_shukuhaku⟧ (accommodation with breakfast)

BREAKFAST OPTIONS:
- ⟦{和食|わしょく}→和食：10436_washoku⟧ (Japanese breakfast)
- ⟦{洋食|ようしょく}→洋食：13274_youshoku⟧ (Western breakfast)
- ⟦バイキング→バイキング：21783_baikingu⟧/⟦ビュッフェ→ビュッフェ：11156_byuffe⟧ (buffet)
